thesis: Educational and interactive applications should diagnose missing distinctions while measuring transfer, autonomy and consequences.
role: Connect learning to human and action settings without assuming efficacy.

ideas.statement: Educational and interactive applications should diagnose missing distinctions while measuring transfer, autonomy and consequences.
ideas.recurrenceCandidate: Connect learning to human and action settings without assuming efficacy.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Implication versus converse and approval versus execution supply testable distinctions.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: A learner is not a permanent error label; simulated diagnosis does not prove pedagogy and technical adequacy may miss social effects.

audit.notes: Source-grounded analysis; proposed mechanisms and limited guarantees preserved.
